correctness.rationale: The specified four-marker transitive rooted frame F_G* has reflexive root and graph vertices and exactly three irreflexive marker worlds. Under any onto relation-preserving stable map from a rooted upset of F_G* to F_H*, all target marker preimages must be the three source markers. Since a and b have a common predecessor only at r, the upset must be the entire frame; a dead-end c and a->c distinguish a/b, and reflexivity/root reachability fix r. Image graph vertices are vertices; v->c forces color 0, b->v forces color 1, and directed color-0-to-1 arcs preserve graph edges. Thus a stable frame surjection is exactly a color-preserving onto graph homomorphism; conversely such h extends by fixed markers. The stable canonical formula counterframe condition and finite-model property translate this into L_G subseteq L_H iff G surjects onto H. Color-preserving finite mutual surjections imply isomorphism. Closed walk/backtrack maps give strict descending alternating-cycle chain; any finite counterframe is smaller than sufficiently large F_C2n*, proving the intersection K4. Read source verify.py checking 529 ordered pairs of 23 labeled bipartite graphs and cycle maps; general proof is structural, not empirical.

value.rationale: A complete embedding of a familiar graph morphism order into a natural interval of stable modal logics yields systematic comparabilities and incomparabilities and supplies a concrete infinite strictly descending hierarchy with exact infimum. The order structure is not merely another counting example, and the dependence on previously known stable images is explicitly credited.
